methods.target_objective: move unlabeled target feature moments toward source moments without changing source classifier

methods.target_gap: multivariate covariance + mean shift left after marginal alignment
methods.target_objective: target-to-source CORAL; minimize covariance mismatch ||C_t'-C_s||_F while preserving the frozen source classifier; blend raw and full CORAL by beta
fit source-vs-unlabeled-target logistic domain classifier on file means; convert source target-odds into clipped importance weights, then refit the same frozen RF family on labeled source only

pseudo_label_policy.reason: avoid self-training/self-confirmation under unknown A-P truth
pseudo_label_policy.diagnostic_only: report accepted-file coverage, class counts/entropy; on held pseudo-target also report accepted pseudo-label precision after prediction; never use these thresholds to update the model

stability.rule: all candidate/config tuning scores are averaged over the same three seeds and the same loads0/1/2
stability.final_validation: selected family/config only, same three seeds on load3; no retuning after seeing load3

secondary: paired per-file correctness delta vs same-seed no-transfer

class_collapse_rule.pseudo_target: collapse warning if a four-class pseudo-target prediction uses one class for >90% of files or only one predicted class; also report any zero-predicted class
class_collapse_rule.real_target: collapse warning if one predicted class exceeds 90% of A-P files or only one class is predicted; absence of a class is not by itself called wrong because truth is unknown

negative_transfer.final_promotion: selected method may proceed to real A-P only if held-load3 mean Macro-F1 delta >=0, no held-load3 harmed-file excess over improved files, and no collapse warning

source_retention.T1: exact by construction: source model bytes unchanged and target-side adapter is bypassed on source
source_retention.T2: exact by construction: source model bytes unchanged and target-side CORAL is bypassed on source
source_retention.T3: must pass a 4-fold source-retention audit on the frozen 07-A outer source test folds using real A-P only as unlabeled domain data; mean Macro-F1 drop <=0.02 and worst-fold drop <=0.05

tuning_and_selection.within_family: maximize mean tuning Macro-F1 across loads0/1/2 × 3 seeds; tie-break mean min-class Recall, lower harmed-file fraction, then simpler/smaller transform
tuning_and_selection.family_selection: among T1, best T2, and retention-eligible best T3, use the same tuning-only rule; do not use A-P labels or load3 to choose the family
tuning_and_selection.held_validation: evaluate the selected family/config once on load3 across frozen seeds; if promotion rule fails, 09-A fails rather than switching families post hoc
tuning_and_selection.real_target: only after held validation passes, execute the frozen selected adapter on A-P and save adapted window/file model scores and predictions

distribution_warning: lower MMD/domain separability is supporting evidence only and can never substitute for pseudo-target classification metrics
